question_cn: 「后+双车」组合为什么是开局中最强的重子阵型？
question_en: Why is the queen-and-two-rooks setup such a powerful heavy-piece formation in the opening?

options.text_cn: 因为三个棋子价值加起来最大
options.text_en: Because the combined point value of the three pieces is the highest.

options.text_cn: 后覆盖横线和斜线方向，双车控制纵线，三子联合从多个方向同时施压，对方几乎无法防守所有威胁
options.text_en: The queen attacks across ranks and diagonals while the rooks control files, creating threats from several directions that are difficult to defend at once.

options.text_cn: 只要有后就够了，车是辅助
options.text_en: The queen alone is enough; the rooks are merely support.
The queen and two rooks are useful only in the endgame.

explanation_cn: 后控制横线、纵线和两条斜线，双车控制两条纵线（或叠在同一纵线）——三子联合可以从纵、横、斜多个方向同时威胁对方。对方需要用多个棋子才能应付这种立体压力，很容易顾此失彼。在开中局，实现「后+双车连接且在开放线上」就意味着有了发起决定性进攻的基础。
explanation_en: The queen can attack along ranks, files, and diagonals while the rooks control one or two files. Together, they create threats from several directions, forcing the opponent to defend multiple lines at once. Connected queen and rooks on open files provide a strong foundation for a decisive attack.
